message.content: I’ve been dealing with this for four days now, and it’s been getting worse. I don't have any abdominal pain or fever, and I haven't noticed any itching or changes to my urine. As for my history, I don't have liver disease or gallstones, and I don't drink alcohol. I did receive my first dose of pembrolizumab about two weeks ago for my lung cancer. I don't recall any other recent changes to my medications.
